paragraphs.chinese:
这一集基本就是一个漫长的夜晚：几个大人不停告诉自己“一切都在掌控中”，然后一个个证明完全不是这么回事。

在 Jay 和 Gloria 家，Manny 的亲生父亲 Javier 在又一次错过探望之后突然出现。他带着龙虾、礼物、一堆精彩故事，还直接送了 Manny 一部新的拍照手机，Manny 当然开心得不得了。Jay 却怎么看他都不顺眼。在 Jay 看来，Javier 之所以显得那么有魅力，是因为他只负责许下刺激的承诺，然后在真正需要承担父亲责任之前就消失了。

当天晚上，Jay 发现 Javier 在打台球，终于当面把这些话说了出来。Javier 承认，来看 Manny 对他来说也很难，因为 Jay 已经成了 Manny 生活里那个稳定的父亲，他觉得自己根本竞争不过。可聊着聊着，两个人发现彼此都很喜欢棒球。没过多久，Javier 就拉着 Jay 和 Manny 半夜出去打曲线球、吃热狗，玩了一整晚，做的全是 Jay 平时最看不惯的那种疯狂事情。

第二天，Javier 又骑着摩托车出现，还把 Jay 也拉出去兜风。Jay 一直嘴硬说自己全是为了 Manny，可 Gloria 一眼就看出来，他已经彻底被 Javier 的魅力拿下了。当天傍晚，Jay 穿好衣服等着 Javier 来接他，准备一起去见几个以前打过棒球的人。结果 Javier 根本没来。Jay 终于亲身体会了一次 Manny 这些年反复经历的失望。

另一边，Phil 半夜突然肚子剧痛，直接开始怀疑自己要死了。Claire 打了 911。偏偏他们镇上的消防员出了名的帅，于是 Claire 趁人还没到，飞快换了件好看的衣服，甚至还涂了口红。Phil 当场就发现了。他疼得快不行了，却还是挤得出力气来生气。

到了医院，医生发现 Phil 是肾结石。Claire 最后承认，自己的确稍微打扮了一下。她平时大多数时候都穿着旧旧的“妈妈装”，身上还沾着花生酱之类的东西，那一刻她只是想让自己觉得好看一点。Phil 立刻觉得自己拿到了一个“黄金筹码”，以后想要什么都可以拿 Claire 的愧疚来换。可他们还没离开医院，Claire 就发现 Phil 在给一群女人表演纸牌魔术，这个优势很快就没了。

Mitchell 和 Cameron 同一晚也没睡。他们正在训练 Lily 自己入睡。Mitchell 想让她哭一会儿，不要每次都进去抱；Cameron 却根本听不了孩子哭，一次次偷偷进去安慰。两个人吵到最后甚至动起手来，Cameron 还扭伤了脚踝。冷静下来之后，Mitchell 说自己不能永远当那个严厉的爸爸，而 Cameron 永远做温柔好说话的那个。Cameron 也同意，他们得一起分担这两种角色。

到了早上，所有人都累得不行。明明孩子才是需要被照顾的那群人，结果真正失控的反而全是大人。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is basically one long night where the adults keep telling themselves they have everything under control, and then prove the exact opposite.

At Jay and Gloria’s house, Manny’s father Javier suddenly shows up after missing another visit. He arrives with lobsters, gifts, big stories, and a new camera phone for Manny, so of course Manny is thrilled. Jay can’t stand him. To Jay, Javier is charming because he gets to make exciting promises and disappear before he has to deal with the boring part of being a parent.

Later that night, Jay finds Javier playing pool and finally calls him out. Javier admits that coming to see Manny is hard because Jay is now the stable father in Manny’s life, and he feels like he can’t compete with that. Then the two men discover they both love baseball. Before long, Javier has taken Jay and Manny out in the middle of the night to hit curveballs, eat hot dogs, and have the kind of ridiculous adventure Jay normally complains about.

The next day, Javier brings Jay a motorcycle and talks him into going for a ride. Jay keeps insisting he’s only doing all this for Manny, but Gloria can see he’s been completely won over. That evening, Jay gets dressed and waits for Javier to take him out with some former baseball players. Javier never shows. For once, Jay gets to feel exactly what Manny has felt so many times.

Meanwhile, Phil wakes up with terrible stomach pain and becomes convinced he’s dying. Claire calls 911, and because the local firefighters have a reputation for being very attractive, she quickly changes into nicer clothes and even puts on lipstick. Phil notices immediately. He’s in agony, but he still finds enough energy to be offended.

At the hospital, the doctors find a kidney stone. Claire eventually admits that she did dress up a little. She spends most days covered in peanut butter and wearing old mom clothes, and for one second she just wanted to feel attractive. Phil decides this mistake has given him a “golden ticket” he can cash in later whenever he wants something. Unfortunately, before they leave the hospital, Claire catches him entertaining a group of women with card tricks, so that advantage disappears pretty fast.

Mitchell and Cameron spend the same night trying to teach Lily to fall asleep on her own. Mitchell wants to let her cry for a while, but Cameron keeps sneaking in to comfort her. Their argument gets so physical that Cameron hurts his ankle. Afterward, Mitchell explains that he can’t always be the strict parent while Cameron gets to be the cuddly one. Cameron agrees they need to share both jobs.

By morning, everyone is exhausted. The kids may be the ones who need looking after, but the adults are the ones acting completely out of control.
